title: FORGE Response Schema
description: Schema for FORGE [Executor] structured response back to ULTRON. Contains implementation results, file modifications, test outcomes, and build status.

agent.description: Agent identifier — always 'forge' for this response schema

status.description: Overall status of the implementation. 'success' = all tasks completed, 'partial' = some tasks completed, 'error' = could not implement.

summary.description: 1-2 sentence summary of what FORGE implemented. Used by ULTRON for consolidation and by AEGIS for review.

artifacts.description: Concrete outputs produced by FORGE's implementation work

path.description: File path relative to the project root or absolute path

action.description: What was done to the file

modifiedFiles.description: All files created, modified, or deleted during implementation

skipped.description: Number of tests that were skipped

storyFileUpdated.description: Whether the story file was updated with completed task checkboxes

reactIterations.description: ReACT loop iteration details — how many internal REASON-ACT-OBSERVE cycles FORGE ran and what was self-corrected before sending to AEGIS. Optional; defaults indicate single-pass (no ReACT loop).

totalAttempts.description: Total number of REASON-ACT-OBSERVE iterations FORGE executed. 1 = single pass (no self-correction needed).

iteration.description: Which iteration detected and fixed this issue

issue.description: Description of the issue found during OBSERVE phase

fix.description: Description of the fix applied in the subsequent ACT phase

selfCorrections.description: List of issues found and fixed during internal iterations. Empty array if no self-corrections were needed.

finalObserveStatus.description: Final status of the last OBSERVE phase. 'passed' = all checks OK, 'failed' = issues remain (escalated to AEGIS), 'partial' = some checks passed but others could not be verified.

severity.description: Severity of the issue encountered during implementation

issues.description: Issues or blockers encountered during implementation

linesAdded.description: Approximate number of lines added across all files

linesRemoved.description: Approximate number of lines removed across all files

buildStatus.description: Whether the build/compilation passed after implementation

freeText.description: Optional free-text field for additional unstructured context (Phase 1 hybrid mode)

position.description: Agent's position in Deliberative Group Chat. Format: 'agree_with:{agent}', 'disagree', or 'propose:{alternative}'. Null when not participating in a group chat round.

reactEnabled.description: Whether FORGE executed the ReACT (REASON-ACT-OBSERVE) internal loop for this task. True by default; false if FORGE skipped ReACT (e.g. trivial change, or explicitly disabled).

vaultConsulted.description: Confirmation of the MANDATORY step-0 Vault consultation. True = FORGE consulted the Vault paths in context.vaultPaths (or attempted and found them empty) BEFORE implementing. False/absent = not consulted (only acceptable for a new project with an empty Vault). Optional for backward compatibility, but FORGE MUST set it true on every mission.
